facts.claim: Silver Dawn (Silversea Cruises): Entered service 2021; 40,700 GT; 596 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 213 m length; Muse class.
Silver Dawn is an outdoor 1980 stainless steel sculpture by Spanish American artist Manuel Izquierdo, installed at Wallace Park in northwest Portland, Oregon, in the United States.

catalogSpecs.description: Operated by Silversea Cruises; entered service 2021; 40,700 GT; approx. 596 guests at double occupancy.
